topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh no, I can't believe it! We were all set, decorations ready, cake baked, and then suddenly this? I mean, I was so sure it was going to happen tonight. Everyone was talking about it, and you could feel the excitement. How did it just fall apart like that? I hope you know this wasn’t your fault at all. Sometimes these things just go haywire, and it's the last thing anyone expects. But hey, maybe we can still do something, even if it’s just a small get-together. It doesn’t have to be perfect to be fun, right? Let’s figure this out together.
